accumulated_map.scope: all integrated sensor observations along the driven route; disk-backed

road_surface.source: Cityscapes road semantics + current measured LiDAR + LVIMOT estimated pose

measured_road_surface.source: Cityscapes road semantics + current measured LiDAR + LVIMOT estimated pose

map_scope.accumulated: all integrated observations along this run; sensor-estimated; no loop closure

accumulated_map.scope: all integrated sensor observations along the driven route; disk-backed

carla_reference_map_validation.comparison: LVIMOT road-height returns vs CARLA OpenDRIVE road surface
carla_reference_map_validation.scope: final local neighborhood, observed road surface only
carla_reference_map_validation.road_metric_warning: Mixed-scene height proxy, NOT semantic road precision. Ground-height LiDAR on sidewalks or building bases lowers this score even when the estimated 3D coordinates are correct.

measured_road_surface.comparison: Camera-labelled, measured LiDAR road layer vs CARLA OpenDRIVE
measured_road_surface.scope: camera-observed road surface only, final local neighborhood
measured_road_surface.road_metric_warning: Predicted road labels and finite OpenDRIVE sampling can be wrong. This does not certify the full scene or unobserved road.
measured_road_surface.classification_source: Pretrained Cityscapes image semantics and measured LiDAR surface support

carla_reference_map_validation.coordinate_alignment: first GT ego pose, applied only AFTER map estimation; no drift correction
carla_reference_map_validation.limitations: The OpenDRIVE reference is only a sampled drivable-road surface. It cannot validate all 3D buildings, unmapped areas or complete 4D trajectories. Independent CARLA localization and MOT evaluations are reported separately.
